title: Completed-coefficient chain quotient comparison
statement: Fix l, E, T, U and the normalized coefficient restriction d [def-sf-clopen-restriction-data]. For every complex P of completed-coefficient module sheaves and every positive exponent n+1 [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], restriction of its actual termwise quotient is isomorphic to the termwise quotient of its restriction, as completed-coefficient complexes. On every section the isomorphism takes d.finite(s) tensor x to s tensor x. Only the completed-coefficient chain quotient is asserted; no derived comparison or counit equation is part of this statement.

source.place: Tag 06YY, ordinary pullback-tensor-product comparison and the normalized coefficient square.

proof.text: The projection equation of d identifies the two ways of restricting completed scalars on a finite module. Construct the natural isomorphism by identity maps on the underlying abelian sheaves; linearity is exactly that equation.

Choose the normalized ordinary comparison, apply it degreewise, and compose with the degreewise scalar-restriction square. Its section formula follows from the ordinary formula because the restriction square acts by the identity on sections.

proof_origin.place: Tag 06YY and Tag 03EL, degreewise chain quotient construction.

theorem sf_clopen_scalar_chain_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (T : Scheme.{t}) (U : T.Opens)
    (d : SfClopenCoefficientRestriction l E T U) :
    ∃ (quotient : ∀ (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E T) ℤ) (n : ℕ),
      (sfClopenComplexRestriction d).obj (unrestrictedTowerComplex l E T n P) ≅
        unrestrictedTowerComplex l E U.toScheme n ((sfClopenComplexRestriction d).obj P)),
      (∀ P n q V s x, (((quotient P n).hom.f q).val.app (op V))
        (unrestrictedTowerTensorSection l E T n (P.X q)
          (op ((sfClopenSiteInclusion U).obj V)) ((d.finite n).hom.hom.app (op V) s) x) =
        unrestrictedTowerTensorSection l E U.toScheme n
          (((sfClopenComplexRestriction d).obj P).X q) (op V) s x)
